preconditions.description: The length of string x is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The length of string y is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in x)
preconditions.description: String x consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in y)
preconditions.description: String y consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the sum of f(l1, r1, l2, r2) over all valid substring pairs, modulo 998244353.

postconditions.expression: total_sum == sum(f_count(x[l1-1:r1], y[l2-1:r2]) for l1 in range(1, len(x)+1) for r1 in range(l1, len(x)+1) for l2 in range(1, len(y)+1) for r2 in range(l2, len(y)+1))
postconditions.description: The total sum equals the sum of the number of chaotic merging sequences for every pair of non-empty substrings from x and y.

postconditions.expression: all(is_chaotic(merge) for merge in all_valid_merges(x[l1-1:r1], y[l2-1:r2]))
postconditions.description: For any specific substring pair, a merging sequence is counted only if the resulting merged string is chaotic (no two adjacent characters are equal).
